## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The home-directory check in `preview` must be fixed before merge: it compares paths lexically, so a `..` segment or a symlink reads files outside the selected home. The added test exercises only an absolute outside path, which the lexical check does reject.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview(home, relative)`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under the home directory, and `settings_file(home)`, which returns the `settings.toml` path, with a test for each. It also adds `tests/review-note.txt`, a one-line text file that no test reads.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../outside.txt")` returns the contents of a file outside `home` instead of raising `ValueError`. `candidate.is_relative_to(Path(home))` compares path components without collapsing `..`, so `home/../outside.txt` passes. A symlink inside `home` that points outside also passes. — Any caller that passes a user-supplied relative path can read the first 200 characters of any file the process can read. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()`, and extend `test_preview` with a `..` case and a symlink case.
